scope: Visual-only message kinds on the phone: the fast-reply acknowledgement renders as a light dashed bubble, the reply body keeps the standard bubble, and a receipt round (input source task_result or schedule) carries a left accent bar on a faint accent tint. No copy, tooltip, aria text or control is added; the ack keeps its text, role=status and ephemeral lifetime. Post-override applied after the quote-reply overlay; harmony platform only.

replacements: {{ runtimeStatusText }}
